description: The Business section: what the business holds and owes, the latest figures read in from the accounts or an Etsy, eBay or Shopify sales file (sales, costs, profit, cash) against the period before, tax set aside this tax year, and the next tax dates - Self Assessment, Corporation Tax per company, Making Tax Digital. Use for 'how's the business doing', 'how's my shop doing this year', 'what's in my company', 'when's my Corporation Tax due', 'how much have I put aside for tax'.
name: get_business
